topics.title: xAI co-founder's new startup River AI raises $1.1B
topics.why: River AI, founded by xAI co-founder Igor Babuschkin, just landed $1.1B led by General Catalyst with NVIDIA and AMD backing to make custom AI model training easier -- a sign smaller teams may soon build tailored AI without a big ML org.
